summary: CyberloQ Technologies filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing an Operating Agreement forming a 50/50 joint venture with Michigan Secure Capital Group Corp., manager-managed by MSCG with CyberloQ holding consent rights over specified matters. CyberloQ contributes use rights to authentication and geolocation technology plus 200,000,000 Class B Non-Voting shares; MSCG provides compliance, wallet, and commercialization assets. Equal distributions after reserves. Venture-held shares are restricted from transfer or pledge without CyberloQ consent and are reclaimable on uncured MSCG breach. Watch share-count overhang and IP-control risk.
